questions: Is the operation allowed to choose the same bag for both A and B (i.e., moving stones from a bag to itself)?
Are we allowed to move stones from a bag that currently has zero stones, effectively choosing an empty bag as source?
Does the order of bags matter for the XOR calculation, i.e., is B_1 ⊕ B_2 ⊕ ... ⊕ B_N computed based on the original indices regardless of which bags still have stones?
Can we move stones from bag B to bag A in a later operation after moving from A to B earlier, effectively reversing or redistributing stones?
Is the goal to consider all possible sequences of operations (including infinite sequences) or only reachable final states after any finite number of operations?
Are we required to move all stones from the chosen source bag, or can we move only a subset?
Do we consider the XOR of the final stone counts across all N bags, even if some bags end up empty?

Is the operation allowed to be performed on bags that have already been involved in previous moves, potentially creating intermediate states with more than one non-empty bag before final consolidation?
